hooks.command: top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); while [ -n "$top" ] && [ ! -f "$top/.claude/hooks/tool_guard.py" ]; do parent=$(dirname "$top"); [ "$parent" = "$top" ] && break; top=$parent; done; if [ -f "$top/.claude/hooks/tool_guard.py" ]; then uv run --no-project --script "$top/.claude/hooks/tool_guard.py"; fi
